title: Assembling the exact scalar-derived pair from normalized adjunctions
statement: For a ring-sheaf map a:R to S on a site, suppose an exact additive extension functor E has the prescribed change-of-rings object and map formulas. Suppose its ordinary scalar restriction adjunction has the sheafified unit formula and its canonical exact derived functor has an adjunction to derived restriction whose transpose on termwise flat K-flat representatives is the ordinary chain transpose followed by the canonical exact-functor comparison. Then there exists a ScalarDerivedPair with extension exactly E, derived functor exactly E.mapDerivedCategory, and the given derived adjunction (heterogeneously equal after those equalities). The assertion constructs only the normalized pair, with no basis or coordinate conclusions.

proof.text: Use the exact functor canonical homotopy counit and its left-derived universal property for the pair data. Expand scalarPairComplexComparison and the exact-functor homotopy counit on the quotient of a complex. The extra quotient comparison maps are identities. Functoriality on identities and the category identity laws identify this comparison with E.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P; this is invertible for every complex.

Fill the ordinary adjunction and unit fields with the given adjunction and its unit equation. Fill the derived adjunction field with the given derived adjunction. Rewrite its representative comparison using the equality just proved; the supplied chain-transpose equation is now precisely the ScalarDerivedPair normalization field. All functors and adjunctions are the supplied ones, so the three concluding identifications are reflexive.

lean.statement:
theorem exactScalarDerivedPair
    (E : scalarModules J R ⥤ scalarModules J S) [E.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits E] [PreservesFiniteColimits E]
    (hobj : ∀ M, E.obj M = changeOfRings a M)
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : scalarModules J R} (f : M ⟶ N),
      E.map f = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom a M f ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    (adj : E ⊣ scalarRestriction a)
    (hu : ∀ (M : scalarModules J R) (V : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj V),
      ((eqToHom (hobj M)).val.app V) ((adj.unit.app M).val.app V x) =
        (toSheafify J (changeOfRingsPresheaf a M).presheaf).app V
          ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (a.hom.app V).hom).unit.app
            (M.val.obj V) x))
    (δ : E.mapDerivedCategory ⊣ scalarDerivedRestriction a)
    (hn : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarModules J R) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P →
      (∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := R) (P.X n)) →
      ∀ (H : CochainComplex (scalarModules J S) ℤ)
        (g : P ⟶ ((scalarRestriction a).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj H),
      (δ.homEquiv (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj H)).symm
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map g ≫ (scalarRestrictionComparison a).inv.app H) =
        E.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarChainTranspose a E inferInstance adj P H g)) :
    ∃ D : ScalarDerivedPair a,
      D.extension = E ∧ D.derived = E.mapDerivedCategory ∧ HEq δ D.adjunction
